GroupLabel.Name: Group {group} Display Name
GroupLabel.Hint: Override the display name shown in the token HUD and config sheets. Leave blank to use the default label.

GmSeeAll.Name: GM Sees All Groups
GmSeeAll.Hint: When enabled, the GM always sees tokens, tiles, and lights from every perception group at full visibility, regardless of their selected token. When disabled, selecting a token previews that token's perspective: anything outside its perception groups (or otherwise hidden) is dimmed rather than hidden, so the GM can still see and select it. With no token selected, everything returns to normal.

GmSeeAllDisguises.Name: GM Sees True Appearances
GmSeeAllDisguises.Hint: When enabled, the GM always sees every token's real appearance and ignores disguises entirely, regardless of selection. When disabled, selecting a token previews disguises from that token's own perspective: the selected token always shows as itself, and anything it perceives as disguised is shown disguised. With no token selected, the GM sees the default disguised view.

EffectDetail.Name: Effect Detail
EffectDetail.Hint: How much work your computer puts into moment effects. Balanced draws fewer particles. Light draws fewer and updates them half as often, which helps on a laptop. Only affects you.

TokenConfig.SectionLabel: Perceived Reality: Who Can See This Token
TokenConfig.SectionHint: Hide this token from everyone except viewers in the checked groups, or with the matching status effect active. What this token itself can see is set with the eye icon on the token HUD.

TileConfig.SectionHint: Assign this tile to one or more perception groups. Only players whose tokens share a matching group will see this tile rendered on their canvas.

LightConfig.SectionHint: Assign this light to one or more perception groups. Only players whose tokens share a matching group will see this light and its illumination effect.

WallConfig.SectionHintDoor: Assign one or more perception groups. Players whose tokens share a matching group see and use this as a normal door. Everyone else perceives it as a solid wall instead.
WallConfig.SectionHintSecret: Assign one or more perception groups. Players whose tokens share a matching group see and use this secret door as a normal door. Everyone else still perceives a solid wall, as with any secret door.
WallConfig.SectionHintNone: This only has an effect when the wall's Door type is set to Door or Secret Door.

HUD.ButtonTooltip: Perceived Reality: What This Token Can See
HUD.PanelHint: Groups this token is in, so it sees everything tagged with them. Who can see this token is set in its Vision tab.
HUD.FromEffectHint: Granted by an active effect and ends with it. Click to keep it as a permanent pick as well.

Window.Title: Perception
Window.ViewHint: Preview the canvas as a party token or a group sees it. Only affects you, and ends when this window closes.
Window.ModeSeenByHint: Show the groups that can see each thing
Window.ModeSeesHint: Show the groups each token is in, which decide what it sees
Window.FilterTaggedHint: Only show things with a group or a disguise
Window.SelectedEmpty: Select things on the canvas, or pick them from any layer, to change them together.
Window.PickStart: Pick from the canvas on any layer
Window.PickHint: Click picks one thing, Shift+click adds or removes, and the same spot again reaches what's under it. Esc or right-click stops.
Window.DisguiseSet: Disguised for {groups}. Click to open Seen As.
Window.DisguiseNone: No disguise. Click to set one in Seen As.
Window.ChipEffect: {label}, from an active effect. Click to keep it after the effect ends.
Window.TaggedCount: {tagged} of {total} have a group or disguise

Inspector.NoTargets: Nothing of this type on the scene.
Inspector.FxMissing: FXMaster is not active in this world. This clip is kept but will not play.
Inspector.FxPresetEveryone: Presets play for everyone. Use a particle or filter effect to target an audience.
Inspector.DeleteConfirmContent: Delete this clip from the timeline? This cannot be undone.
Inspector.DisguiseUnsetAll: Apply to every token in the scene, not just the ones picked below
Inspector.ResetMood: Put the mood back to the preset
Inspector.ResetBackground: Put the background back to the preset
Inspector.ResetForeground: Put the foreground back to the preset
Inspector.ResetParticles: Put the particles back to the preset
Inspector.PresetNoneHint: None clears this group's atmosphere when the clip plays.

Notify.NoScene: Open or activate a scene first.
Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can run a moment.
Notify.NotFound: No moment named "{name}" on this scene.
Notify.Cleared: Cleared all lingering moment effects for this scene.
Notify.PerceptionCleared: Cleared all moment-granted sight and visibility groupings for this scene.
Notify.DisguisesCleared: Cleared all disguises for this scene.

Moments.ViewAsHint: Preview this session as a specific token would perceive it. Only affects your own screen.
Moments.CatalogEmpty: No moments saved yet. Build one in the Moment Builder and click Save.
Moments.CatalogDeleteContent: Delete "{name}"? This removes its saved timeline and cannot be undone.
Moments.GroupLabelHint: The scene this moment is saved under. A moment always plays on the scene you're viewing. Its token, tile, light and door steps only find their targets on the scene it was made for.

AddHint.transition: A full-screen curtain effect (mist, blackout, rain, and more) that plays for a set duration, then clears.
AddHint.narration: Letterboxed text shown on screen. Can say the same thing to everyone, or diverge so a chosen group reads different text than everyone else.
AddHint.sound: Plays an audio file for a set duration. Can target everyone or just a chosen perception group.
AddHint.perception: Grants or removes a token's ability to see a perception group's tokens, tiles, lights, and doors.
AddHint.object: Adds or removes a perception group tag on specific tokens, tiles, lights, or doors, changing who can see them.
AddHint.atmosphere: A persistent color/vignette/motes preset applied to a perception group's view of the scene, until changed or cleared.
AddHint.fx: A FXMaster particle or filter effect (rain, snow, fog, and more) timed to this clip. Requires the FXMaster module active in this world. Presets play for everyone; particle/filter effects can target a single perception group.
AddHint.disguise: Swaps a token's appearance for one perception group only, until unset. Reuses the same appearance data as the token's own Seen As sheet section - setting one overwrites the other.

Moments.ClearEffectsHint: Clears any transition, narration, atmosphere, and effect overlays showing on this scene for everyone, and ends a running moment.
Moments.ClearPerceptionHint: Immediately removes every sight grant and visibility grouping created by moments for all tokens, tiles, lights, and doors on this scene.
Moments.ClearDisguisesHint: Immediately removes every disguise set on tokens in this scene, restoring their true appearance for everyone.

Help.Start: Seconds from the start of the Moment.
Help.Duration: How long the clip runs, in seconds. Dragging the right edge of the bar does the same.
Help.Audience: Who this clip plays for. Run reaches everyone online, and each person gets only the clips their perception matches.
Help.AudienceGroup: The group checked against each viewer. Nothing is granted or taken away here.
Help.Style: Loads a full set of colors, particles, coverage and timing. Overwrites everything below it, so choose it first.
Help.PrimaryColor: Color of the particles and the glow at the center.
Help.BackdropColor: Color of the solid backing that blocks the scene.
Help.Particles: Number of particles drawn. Appearance only, it does not affect coverage.
Help.SceneBlur: Blurs the scene behind the curtain. Blur hides detail but movement still shows, so use coverage to hide changes.
Help.Intensity: Opacity of the colors and particles. Appearance only, it does not affect coverage.
Help.Cover: How much of the scene the curtain hides at its peak. At 100 nothing shows through, at 0 only the particles and glow are drawn over it.
Help.Hold: Seconds held at full coverage, shown as the hatched band on the bar. Put perception, grouping and disguise markers inside it.
Help.Text: Shown to anyone without a group override below.
Help.GroupOverrides: Replacement text for one group. That group reads this instead of the line above.
Help.SoundPath: Audio file to play. Plays only for the audience above.
Help.Volume: Clip volume, applied before Foundry's ambient volume.
Help.Loop: Repeat until the clip ends instead of playing once.
Help.PerceptionAction: Grant adds the group to the targets, remove takes it away.
Help.PerceptionGroup: The group being added or removed.
Help.TargetType: Whether the targets are tokens or doors.
Help.PerceptionTargets: The tokens being changed, not the tokens doing the seeing.
Help.GroupingAction: Add puts the targets in the group, remove takes them out.
Help.GroupingGroup: The group being added to or removed from.
Help.GroupingTargets: What is being tagged. Grouping sets who can see a thing, perception sets what a token can see.
Help.AtmosphereGroup: Who the atmosphere applies to. Everyone else sees the scene unchanged.
Help.Preset: Loads a mood, a background, a foreground and any particles, with a starting value for each. Choose it first. Each section can then be changed on its own and put back with its reset icon. Reset to preset puts everything back.
Help.Saturation: Color intensity of the scene. 0 is grayscale, 100 is unchanged.
Help.Brightness: Brightness of the scene. 100 is unchanged.
Help.HueShift: Rotates every color in the scene, in degrees.
Help.TintEnabled: Whether a color wash is drawn over the scene.
Help.VignetteColor: Color drawn at the edges of the screen.
Help.VignetteStrength: How far the edge color reaches toward the center.
Help.AtmoAutoEnd: Clears itself after this many seconds. Never keeps it until it is cleared by hand or another atmosphere replaces it.
Help.DisguiseAction: Set applies a disguise to the targets, unset removes it.
Help.DisguiseGroup: The group that gets fooled. Its members see the disguise, or stop seeing it once it is unset. Everyone outside the group always sees the real token, whatever their own perception groups.
Help.ParticleColor: The color they are drawn in.
Help.ParticleOpacity: Opacity of the whole layer. Lower it to let the mood colors show more, or set it to 0 to turn the layer off.
Help.ParticleDensity: How many are drawn, against the normal count.
Help.ParticleSpeed: How fast they move. 100 is the normal rate, 50 is half of it.
Help.ParticleSize: Scales the particles up or down. They still vary in size.
Help.ParticleAngle: The bearing they travel on. 0 is up, 90 is right, 180 is down.
Help.ParticleEye: How wide the opening in the middle is. Small leaves a little gap at the center, large pushes the swirl out to the edges.
Help.SheenFrom: The edge the sheen enters from.
Help.SheenTo: The edge it leaves by. The same edge it arrived at makes it withdraw, the opposite one makes it pass through.
Help.SheenTilt: Turns the whole sweep, so the bars lie on a diagonal instead of square to the screen.
Help.ParticleStyle: A second small effect drawn over the foreground. Pick the same style as the foreground for more of it, or give it a different color or size to vary it. Leave it at None to keep the foreground alone.
Help.SheenCascade: How far apart the bars start and finish. Low and they move almost together, high and they arrive one at a time.
Help.ParticleSpread: How much of the color wheel it uses, starting from the particle color.
Help.ParticleBands: How many curtains hang one behind another. The nearest is the tallest and brightest, and each one behind it sits farther off, shorter and dimmer.
Help.ParticleColor_aurora: The body of the curtain. The bright lower edge is a lighter version of it, and Color spread shifts the top and the fringe away from it.
Help.ParticleDensity_surge: How often a burst of water fires, and how many droplets each one throws.
Help.ParticleDensity_aurora: How finely the curtains are streaked with rays.
Help.ParticleDensity_vortex: How many arms the whirlpool turns.
Help.ParticleSize_aurora: How tall the curtains hang and how deep their folds run.
Help.ParticleSize_vortex: How far the whirlpool reaches from its center.
Help.ParticleSize_surge: How far each burst of water spreads.
Help.ParticleAngle_aurora: The way the rays stream from their bright lower edge, which turns the whole display. 0 is up, 90 is right, 180 is down.
Help.ParticleSpread_aurora: How far the top of each curtain and the fringe along its lower edge shift from the body color, like green curtains going violet at the top.
Help.ParticleGlow: Draws the particles as light: above the scene's darkness, so they stay bright at night, while fog of war still hides them. A glowing effect sits above any weather, the way FXMaster's embers and stars do. Only for Over the scene.
Help.BackgroundStyle: Fills the scene behind everything else in the atmosphere.
Help.ForegroundStyle: The atmosphere's main motion, drawn over the background.
Help.Placement: Where the whole atmosphere is drawn. Over the scene draws above everything on the map and below weather, On the ground draws under the tokens. Over the scene, the roof your token stands under is cut out so the sky stays outside the building.
Help.MainGlow: Draws the background and foreground as light: above the scene's darkness, so they stay bright at night, while fog of war still hides them. A glowing effect sits above any weather, the way FXMaster's embers and stars do. Only for Over the scene.
Help.ParticleColor_blooms: Where each bloom's colors start. Color spread sets how far round the wheel it goes from here.
Help.ParticleDensity_blooms: How often a bloom opens, and how many are already open when it starts.
Help.ParticleSpread_blooms: How much of the color wheel a bloom uses. At 0 it stays one color, at full it uses the whole wheel.
Help.ParticleColor_prism: Where the sheen's spectrum starts. Color spread sets how far round the wheel it goes from here.
Help.ParticleSpread_prism: How much of the color wheel the sheen uses. At 0 it stays one color, at full it uses the whole wheel.

Moments.StopMomentHint: Ends the running moment so nothing else plays. Grants and disguises it already applied stay.
Moments.GroupAwayHint: Made for {scene}. Playing it uses the scene you're viewing, {viewing}.
Moments.MissingTargetsHint: Some steps point at tokens, tiles, lights or doors that aren't on the scene you're viewing. Those steps are skipped when the moment plays here.
Moments.PlayMissingContent: {count} step targets aren't on {scene}, so those steps will be skipped.
Moments.SwitchContent: Save your changes to the moments for {group} before switching?

Disguise.SectionHint: Each row below fools one perception group with a fake appearance instead of the truth. This is the opposite of the Perception checklist above: there, matching a group reveals the token; here, matching a group hides the truth and shows the disguise instead. Everyone outside the chosen group still sees this token as it really is.
Disguise.ToggleLabel: Enable or disable this group's disguise
Disguise.HideNameplate: Hide nameplate on hover / selection for this group
Disguise.HideNameplateHint: Off by default - allies usually still see a name on hover, just the disguised one.
